description: Paired Apple-to-Apple Baseline: Bruckner (2026) 10 single-word tasks (Table I of arXiv:2607.10252v1)

single_word.en: You are a direct-response assistant. Respond with ONLY a single word or number. No explanation, no punctuation.
single_word.zh: 你是一个直接回答的助手。请仅回复一个词或一个数字。不要包含任何解释或标点符号。

prompts.en: Name a random number between 1 and 100. Answer with one number only.
prompts.zh: 随机说出一个1到100之间的整数。仅回答一个数字。

prompts.en: Name a random number between 1 and 10. Answer with one number only.
prompts.zh: 随机说出一个1到10之间的整数。仅回答一个数字。

prompts.en: What is your favorite number? Answer with one number only.
prompts.zh: 你最喜欢的数字是什么？仅回答一个数字。

prompts.en: Name a random letter of the English alphabet. Answer with one letter only.
prompts.zh: 随机说出一个英文字母。仅回答一个字母。

prompts.en: Name a random word. Answer with one word only.
prompts.zh: 随机说出一个词。仅回答一个词。

prompts.en: Name a random color. Answer with one word only.
prompts.zh: 随机说出一种颜色名称。仅回答一个词。

prompts.en: What is your favorite color? Answer with one word only.
prompts.zh: 你最喜欢什么颜色？仅回答一个词。

prompts.en: Name a random animal. Answer with one word only.
prompts.zh: 随机说出一种动物。仅回答一个词。

prompts.en: Name a random city. Answer with one word only.
prompts.zh: 随机说出一个城市名称。仅回答一个词。

prompts.en: Flip a coin: heads or tails? Answer with one word only.
prompts.zh: 抛硬币：正面还是反面？仅回答一个词。
